matches.rationale: The ground truth describes a root-cause reference-frame mistake that propagates through the paper's equations, producing spurious extra (1+z) factors. Finding 1 directly identifies the double-counting of relative-motion/aberration effects that inflates d_L by (1+z)^2, and finding 2 shows the same kind of spurious (1+z)^2 factor corrupting the Etherington relation derivation—both are downstream symptoms of the same systemic frame-assumption error described in the ground truth.
